name: Oba Makarnacilik
summary: Oba Makarnacilik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and sells pasta in Turkey and internationally. The company offers children pasta, mac and cheese, noodles, flour, and semolina products. It sells its products under the OBA Makarna, OBA Mie, OBA Gold, Obalino, Nido, Eva, Omelia, Pasta Layla, Pasta Savana, Vera, Rosa Linda, and Nido brands. The company was formerly known as Türsan Kollektif Sirketi Selahattin Öztahtaci, Abdullah Incetahtaci, Adil Ceydeli and changed its name to Oba Makarnacilik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. in December 1988. The company was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Gaziantep, Turkey. Oba Makarnacilik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Alpinvest Yatirim Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret AS.
